title: "Heaven speaks in whispers the proud can’t hear."
paragraphs: "Heaven speaks in whispers the proud can’t hear."

Power isn’t always loud.
Some victories echo. Others whisper eternity.

James 4:6 (ESV)
“God opposes the proud but gives grace to the humble.”
🔥 The essence of “when the mighty boast” — pride invites divine resistance, humility receives divine whisper.
